fields.description: Issue includes extensive local nightlife and entertainment listings and commentary, recurring gossip/column items ("They Tell Me"), and prominent coverage of horse racing and betting information connected to Hialeah and Tropical Park. Also includes discussion of Miami civic and tourism-related organizations (including state societies and the Chamber of Commerce), liquor-law enforcement and licensing concerns, and numerous advertisements for clubs, bars, restaurants, services, and local businesses in the Miami area.
